title: Planning algorithms on the shared Grid World
description: Run Value Iteration, Policy Iteration, and Truncated Policy Iteration from the same model, then compare how values, policies, and work evolve.
ready: Planning engine ready. Choose an algorithm and advance one outer iteration.
working: Rust is evaluating and improving the selected policy.
failed: The planning engine could not start. The static explanation remains available below.
resetDone: The selected algorithm was reset to its initial value and policy.
paused: Paused {algorithm} after outer iteration {iteration}. Current residual: {residual}.
converged: {algorithm} reached its stopping condition after outer iteration {iteration}.
limitReached: {algorithm} reached the outer-iteration limit before the stopping condition.
deterministic: Model-based planning · complete transition model · no trajectory sampling
truncatedPolicyIterationFormula: evaluate π for N sweeps → improve
mapBody: Each column is one algorithm at the same outer-iteration frontier. Arrows show the canonical policy; the text also reports every tied greedy action.
stateAria: {algorithm}, state s{state}, {kind}; value {value}; policy {policy}; greedy actions {greedy}
terminalNoActions: The terminal goal has no outgoing decision row and remains fixed at zero.
evaluationTruncated: The PI inner evaluation reached its safety cap; this outer step remains approximate.
phaseBody: Value Iteration performs a Bellman backup; Policy Iteration evaluates a policy to the inner tolerance and improves it; Truncated PI performs exactly N evaluation sweeps before improvement.
noPhase: Advance an algorithm to reveal its evaluation/improvement phases.
costBody: Counts are model operations, not wall-clock promises. A sweep accounts for every row of the fixed-size value vector (the terminal row is a fixed no-op); an improvement pass compares all requested actions.
costFormula: total = backups + action expectations + policy-evaluations + improvements
residualBody: The exact history for each algorithm is listed so a chart never hides an inner evaluation sweep or an honest truncation.
historyAria: Planning residual histories by outer iteration
historyDescription: Three lines show optimality residuals for Value Iteration, Policy Iteration, and Truncated Policy Iteration. The table below lists each algorithm's latest values.
referenceBody: The high-precision optimal reference is shared by all three procedures. A policy can be stable before its displayed values reach that reference when evaluation is truncated.
auditBody: These checks are recomputed from the transition ledger and every algorithm snapshot.
auditRows: Every nonterminal state–action probability row sums to one
auditTerminal: The terminal goal has value zero and no policy action
auditFinite: All values, policies, costs, and residuals are finite
auditPolicies: Policy masks contain one canonical action for every decision state
auditReference: The shared reference has negligible residual
auditModes: All three modes expose the same transition model
errorPrefix: The planning engine rejected the command.

errors.planning_discount_range: The discount factor must be finite and between 0 and 0.99.
errors.planning_slip_range: Wind probability must be finite and between 0 and 1.
errors.planning_tolerance_range: The tolerance must be finite, greater than 0, and no greater than 1.
errors.planning_outer_iterations_range: Maximum outer iterations must be an integer from 1 through 10,000.
errors.planning_max_outer_iterations_range: Maximum outer iterations must be an integer from 1 through 10,000.
errors.planning_evaluation_sweeps_range: Truncated PI evaluation sweeps must be an integer from 1 through 10,000 and no greater than the safety cap.
errors.planning_max_evaluation_sweeps_range: The PI evaluation safety cap must be an integer from 1 through 10,000.
errors.planning_evaluation_budget: Truncated PI evaluation sweeps cannot exceed the PI safety cap.
errors.planning_reward_range: Every reward must be finite with magnitude at most 1,000,000.
errors.planning_restore_iterations: The stored outer iteration is outside the configured limit.
errors.planning_advance_iterations: The internal outer-iteration chunk is outside its safe limit.
errors.worker_error: The experiment Worker reported an unexpected error.
errors.planning_mode: The requested planning algorithm is not available.
errors.planning_unknown_mode: The requested planning algorithm is not available.
